
		<h2>
			<a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiangji/p/19205850" title="发布于 2025-11-10 09:19">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">鸡肋的TaskFactory是时候抛弃了</span>
    

</a>

		</h2>
		<div class="postText">    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        TaskFactory调用系统线程池来执行Task
手搓线程池不一定要依赖TaskFactory就能直接执行Task
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="一taskfactory的作用">一、TaskFactory的作用</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过TaskFactoryk可以生成Task</li>
<li>并在系统线程池中执行</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="1-taskfactorystartnew调用同步方法的case">1. TaskFactory.StartNew调用同步方法的Case</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>以下是Task经典的Case</li>
<li>使用TaskFactory的StartNew异步执行3个耗时1秒的任务</li>
<li>共耗时1秒</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp"> var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
 var task = Task.Factory.StartNew(() =&gt; Hello("张三", 1000));
 var task2 = Task.Factory.StartNew(() =&gt; Hello("李四", 1000));
 var task3 = Task.Factory.StartNew(() =&gt; Hello("王二", 1000));
 await Task.WhenAll(task, task2, task3);
 sw.Stop();
 _output.WriteLine($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} Total Span :{sw.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds}");

void Hello(string name, int time = 10)
{
    Thread.Sleep(time);
    _output.WriteLine($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} Hello {name},{DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss.fff}");
}

// Thread10 Hello 张三,16:13:03.553
// Thread31 Hello 王二,16:13:03.553
// Thread11 Hello 李四,16:13:03.553
// Thread17 Total Span :1010.0936
</code></pre>
<h2 id="二taskrun也能生成并执行task">二、Task.Run也能生成并执行Task</h2>
<h3 id="1-taskrun调用同步方法的case">1. Task.Run调用同步方法的Case</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>Task.Run也可以生成并执行同步方法</li>
<li>TaskFactory的StartNew效果差不多</li>
<li>区别在于Task.Run是静态方法</li>
<li>TaskFactory.StartNew是实例方法,可以手搓(自定义)</li>
<li>参考笔者博文<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiangji/p/19198381" target="_blank">重构《手搓》TaskFactory带你更安全的起飞</a></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
var task = Task.Run(() =&gt; Hello("张三", 1000));
var task2 = Task.Run(() =&gt; Hello("李四", 1000));
var task3 = Task.Run(() =&gt; Hello("王二", 1000));
await Task.WhenAll(task, task2, task3);
sw.Stop();
_output.WriteLine($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} Total Span :{sw.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds}");

// Thread31 Hello 王二,16:22:43.545
// Thread10 Hello 张三,16:22:43.545
// Thread11 Hello 李四,16:22:43.545
// Thread15 Total Span :1014.1269
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-taskrun还能调用异步方法的case">2. Task.Run还能调用异步方法的Case</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>Task.Run还可以胜任异步处理</li>
<li>不知为啥TaskFactory不支持该功能</li>
<li>TaskFactory.FromAsync应该能实现类似功能,但明显用起来不方便</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
var task = Task.Run(() =&gt; HelloAsync("张三", 1000));
var task2 = Task.Run(() =&gt; HelloAsync("李四", 1000));
var task3 = Task.Run(() =&gt; HelloAsync("王二", 1000));
await Task.WhenAll(task, task2, task3);
sw.Stop();
_output.WriteLine($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} Total Span :{sw.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds}");

async Task HelloAsync(string name, int time = 10, CancellationToken token = default)
{
    await Task.Delay(time, token);
    _output.WriteLine($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} HelloAsync {name},{DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss.fff}");
}

// Thread31 HelloAsync 张三,01:35:17.541
// Thread11 HelloAsync 王二,01:35:17.541
// Thread8 HelloAsync 李四,01:35:17.541
// Thread17 Total Span :1008.7947
</code></pre>
<h2 id="三手搓taskfactory能兼顾">三、《手搓》TaskFactory能兼顾</h2>
<h3 id="1-手搓taskfactory调用同步方法的case">1. 《手搓》TaskFactory调用同步方法的Case</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>《手搓》TaskFactory可平替系统Factory调用同步方法</li>
<li>还能实现系统Factory做不到的并发控制</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var options = new ReduceOptions { ConcurrencyLevel = 3 };
var factory = new ConcurrentTaskFactory(options);
var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
var task = factory.StartNew(() =&gt; Hello("张三", 1000));
var task2 = factory.StartNew(() =&gt; Hello("李四", 1000));
var task3 = factory.StartNew(() =&gt; Hello("王二", 1000));
await Task.WhenAll(task, task2, task3);
sw.Stop();
_output.WriteLine($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} Total Span :{sw.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds}");

// Thread11 Hello 张三,01:50:15.835
// Thread8 Hello 李四,01:50:15.835
// Thread31 Hello 王二,01:50:15.835
// Thread15 Total Span :1010.3326
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-手搓taskfactory调用异步方法的case">2. 《手搓》TaskFactory调用异步方法的Case</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>《手搓》TaskFactory也能调用异步方法</li>
<li>《手搓》TaskFactory可以平替系统Task.Run调用异步方法</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var options = new ReduceOptions { ConcurrencyLevel = 3 };
var factory = new ConcurrentTaskFactory(options);
var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
var task = factory.StartTask(() =&gt; HelloAsync("张三", 1000));
var task2 = factory.StartTask(() =&gt; HelloAsync("李四", 1000));
var task3 = factory.StartTask(() =&gt; HelloAsync("王二", 1000));
await Task.WhenAll(task, task2, task3);
sw.Stop();
_output.WriteLine($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} Total Span :{sw.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds}");

// Thread31 HelloAsync 张三,01:57:06.110
// Thread8 HelloAsync 王二,01:57:06.110
// Thread11 HelloAsync 李四,01:57:06.110
// Thread17 Total Span :1004.2208
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3-手搓taskfactory支持安全双保险">3. 《手搓》TaskFactory支持安全双保险</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>《手搓》TaskFactory支持Token安全保护</li>
<li>《手搓》TaskFactory还支持ItemLife安全保护</li>
<li>系统的Factory和Task.Run只能在调用时判断Token是否取消,安全作用几乎可以忽略</li>
<li>《手搓》TaskFactory也是Factory</li>
<li>既然《手搓》TaskFactory那么强大,为什么还说鸡肋呢?</li>
<li>那是因为这些都是《手搓》线程池提供的技术支持</li>
<li>完全可以直接通过《手搓》线程池实现</li>
<li>可以参考以前的文章<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiangji/p/19192440" target="_blank">异步"伪线程"重构《手搓》线程池,支持任务清退</a></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var options = new ReduceOptions { ConcurrencyLevel = 1, ItemLife = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1) };
var factory = new ConcurrentTaskFactory(options);
var tokenSource = new CancellationTokenSource();
tokenSource.CancelAfter(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1));
var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
var task = factory.StartTask(() =&gt; HelloAsync("张三", 2000, tokenSource.Token));
Assert.NotNull(task);
try
{
    await task;
    sw.Stop();
}
catch (Exception ex)
{
    sw.Stop();
    _output.WriteLine(($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} {ex}"));
}
_output.WriteLine($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} Total Span :{sw.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds}");
await Task.Delay(2000);

// Thread17 System.Threading.Tasks.TaskCanceledException: A task was canceled.
//    at TaskTests.Tasks.ConcurrentTaskFactoryTests.TaskItemLife() in D:\projects\HandCore.net\UnitTests\TaskTests\Tasks\ConcurrentTaskFactoryTests.cs:line 72
// Thread17 Total Span :1017.4384
</code></pre>
<h2 id="四手搓线程池的task">四、《手搓》线程池的Task</h2>
<h3 id="1-手搓线程池直接调用同步方法的case">1. 《手搓》线程池直接调用同步方法的Case</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过Processor可以直接生成异步</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var options = new ReduceOptions { ConcurrencyLevel = 3 };
var processor = new Processor();
var pool = options.CreateJob(processor);
var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
var task = processor.StartNew(() =&gt; Hello("张三", 1000));
var task2 = processor.StartNew(() =&gt; Hello("李四", 1000));
var task3 = processor.StartNew(() =&gt; Hello("王二", 1000));
await Task.WhenAll(task, task2, task3);
sw.Stop();
_output.WriteLine($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} Total Span :{sw.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds}");

// Thread31 Hello 王二,02:15:07.714
// Thread10 Hello 李四,02:15:07.714
// Thread11 Hello 张三,02:15:07.714
// Thread16 Total Span :1011.4239
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-手搓线程池直接调用异步方法的case">2. 《手搓》线程池直接调用异步方法的Case</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过Processor可以直接调用异步方法</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var options = new ReduceOptions { ConcurrencyLevel = 3 };
var processor = new Processor();
var pool = options.CreateJob(processor);
var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
var task = processor.StartTask(() =&gt; HelloAsync("张三", 1000, CancellationToken.None));
var task2 = processor.StartTask(() =&gt; HelloAsync("李四", 1000, CancellationToken.None));
var task3 = processor.StartTask(() =&gt; HelloAsync("王二", 1000, CancellationToken.None));
await Task.WhenAll(task, task2, task3);
sw.Stop();
_output.WriteLine($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} Total Span :{sw.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds}");

// Thread8 HelloAsync 李四,02:25:06.458
// Thread11 HelloAsync 张三,02:25:06.458
// Thread31 HelloAsync 王二,02:25:06.458
// Thread17 Total Span :1005.3909
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3-手搓线程池双保险执行task的case">3. 《手搓》线程池双保险执行Task的Case</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>《手搓》线程池支持双保险执行Task</li>
<li>实际上QueueTaskScheduler(《手搓》TaskFactory核心组件)相当于一个特殊的Processor</li>
<li>ConcurrentTaskFactory内部就包含了一个手搓线程池</li>
<li>从某种意义来说,ConcurrentTaskFactory(《手搓》TaskFactory)有点多余</li>
<li>《手搓》线程池几乎能实现《手搓》TaskFactory的所有功能</li>
<li>还能提供其他更多功能</li>
<li>也可以说《手搓》TaskFactory是阉割版的线程池</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var options = new ReduceOptions { ConcurrencyLevel = 1 };
var processor = new Processor();
var pool = options.CreateJob(processor);
var tokenSource = new CancellationTokenSource();
tokenSource.CancelAfter(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1));
var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
var task = processor.StartTask(() =&gt; HelloAsync("张三", 2000, tokenSource.Token));
Assert.NotNull(task);
try
{
    await task;
    sw.Stop();
}
catch (Exception ex)
{
    sw.Stop();
    _output.WriteLine(($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} {ex}"));
}
_output.WriteLine($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} Total Span :{sw.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds}");
await Task.Delay(2000);

// Thread17 System.Threading.Tasks.TaskCanceledException: A task was canceled.
//    at TaskTests.Job.ProcessorTests.HelloAsync(String name, Int32 time, CancellationToken token) in D:\projects\HandCore.net\UnitTests\TaskTests\Job\ProcessorTests.cs:line 207
//    at Hand.Tasks.Internal.TaskFuncState.RunAsync(CancellationToken token) in D:\projects\HandCore.net\Hand.Tasks\Internal\TaskFuncState.cs:line 32
//    at Hand.Job.Processor.Hand.Job.IQueueProcessor&lt;Hand.States.IState&lt;System.Boolean&gt;&gt;.Run(IQueue`1 queue, ThreadJobService`1 service, CancellationToken token) in D:\projects\HandCore.net\Hand.Job\Processor.cs:line 155
//    at TaskTests.Job.ProcessorTests.TaskItemLife() in D:\projects\HandCore.net\UnitTests\TaskTests\Job\ProcessorTests.cs:line 189
// Thread17 Total Span :1008.4003
</code></pre>
<h2 id="五手搓线程池与系统线程池有区别吗">五、《手搓》线程池与系统线程池有区别吗?</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>当然有区别,而且区别很大</li>
<li>系统线程池是面对过程的,也就是委托方法,可以带一个object参数</li>
<li>《手搓》线程池是面向对象的</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="1-手搓线程池的组成">1. 《手搓》线程池的组成</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>其一要处理的对象类型</li>
<li>其二对象集合(队列)</li>
<li>其三是处理器(处理逻辑)</li>
<li>可以支持高度定制</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">class ReduceJobService&lt;TItem&gt;
{
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 队列
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    public IQueue&lt;TItem&gt; Queue { get; }
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 处理器
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    public IQueueProcessor&lt;TItem&gt; Processor { get; }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="1-手搓线程池默认处理器">1. 《手搓》线程池默认处理器</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>这是一个有状态任务处理器</li>
<li>线程池保护可以基于这个状态</li>
<li>其中的状态为bool类型,true为有效,false就表示线程池应该清退它</li>
<li>Processor支持同步(IJobItem)和异步(IAsyncJobItem)两种任务</li>
<li>通过实现IExceptionable订阅异常处理</li>
<li>通过实现ICancelable订阅取消处理</li>
<li>为了兼容系统线程池使用习惯,默认提供了基于委托(方法)的处理逻辑</li>
<li>实际《手搓》线程池是面向对象的</li>
<li>《手搓》线程池是可以高度私人订制的线程池</li>
<li>有谁会不喜欢私人定制自己的线程池呢</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">class Processor(IQueue&lt;IState&lt;bool&gt;&gt; queue)
    : IQueueProcessor&lt;IState&lt;bool&gt;&gt;;
/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 状态
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
/// &lt;typeparam name="TStatus"&gt;&lt;/typeparam&gt;
interface IState&lt;TStatus&gt;
{
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 状态
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    TStatus Status { get; }
}
interface IExceptionable
{
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 触发异常回调
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="exception"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
    void OnException(Exception exception);
}
interface ICancelable
{
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 取消
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    void OnCancel();
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-手搓线程池支持私人定制任务">2. 《手搓》线程池支持私人定制任务</h3>
<h4 id="21-必需实现接口istatebool">2.1 必需实现接口IState&lt;bool&gt;</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>只有一个Status属性告诉线程池你这个任务当前是否有效</li>
<li>如果Status为false线程池不会执行,直接忽略该任务</li>
<li>如果执行中途变成false,线程池会清退该任务</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="22-实现ijobitem或iasyncjobitem">2.2 实现IJobItem或IAsyncJobItem</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>同步处理实现IJobItem</li>
<li>异步处理实现IAsyncJobItem</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="23-可选实现iexceptionable">2.3 可选实现IExceptionable</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>实现IExceptionable可以订阅异常处理</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="24-可选实现icancelable">2.4 可选实现ICancelable</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>实现ICancelable可以订阅取消处理</li>
<li>特别要注意,有些取消往往会触发异常</li>
<li>如果要完全处理取消,一般IExceptionable也是要实现的</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="3-手搓线程池支持私人定制处理器">3. 《手搓》线程池支持私人定制处理器</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过实现定义IQueueProcessor接口可以定制处理器</li>
<li>定制自己的处理器逻辑可能是一个更好的选择</li>
<li>比如为了性能专门处理异步或同步</li>
<li>或者处理特殊的数据结构和封装自己的异常处理逻辑</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="4-actionprocessor">4. ActionProcessor</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>ActionProcessor非常简单,只支持执行Action</li>
<li>正应为它逻辑简单,能获得更好的性能,专制这方面的强迫症患者</li>
<li>虽然简单,线程池的任务清退和并发控制一点都不打折</li>
<li>把它是比喻为小李飞刀一点都不为过</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp"> var options = new ReduceOptions { ConcurrencyLevel = 1 };
 var pool = options.CreateJob(ActionProcessor.Instance);
 pool.Add(() =&gt; Hello("张三"));
 pool.Add(() =&gt; Hello("李四"));
 await Task.Delay(1000);

void Hello(string name)
{
    _output.WriteLine($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} Hello {name},{DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss.fff}");
    Thread.Sleep(1);
}

// Thread11 Hello 张三,09:57:57.195
// Thread11 Hello 李四,09:57:57.202
</code></pre>
